{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Tailored wool-blend blazer, relaxed fit jacket cut, knee-length hemline, charcoal grey color #36454F, fine melton fabric.
Silk-cady blouse, slightly loose shirt cut with a dropped shoulder, hip-length tunic shape, soft ivory color #FFFFF0, smooth woven silk fabric.
High-waisted pleated wool trousers, straight-leg pant cut, full-length ankle hem, deep navy blue color #000080, heavy wool flannel fabric.
Suede ankle boots, classic Chelsea boot cut with an elastic side panel, mid-calf height, rich brown color #A0522D, soft nappa suede fabric.

This outfit works perfectly for walking to work in the rain during autumn because the wool-blend blazer and heavy flannel trousers provide essential protection against the chill and moisture while maintaining a professional silhouette. The slightly relaxed cut of the blouse adds comfort needed for a long commute on foot without sacrificing the neat business dress code required for the office. The requested suede ankle boots fulfill her specific wish for this footwear choice, offering both style and practicality for wet weather conditions."}
